description: List the signed-in client's upcoming Norm appointments with the `bookingId` that `cancel_appointment` takes. With `includePast: true` it also returns recent past visits, each with `rebook` ids for booking the same service (and master) again via `find_slots`. Requires sign-in to Norm.

includePast.description: Also return recent past visits, for questions about the client's visit history or to book the same as last time. Default: upcoming only.

name: my_appointments
title: List the client's appointments
